test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A certain number of persons are sitting in a row, facing North G is sixth to the right of D.

G is an immediate neighbour of both H and E. C is to the immediate right to E. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
Given: A certain number of persons are sitting in a row, facing North.

1) G is sixth to the right of D.

2) G is an immediate neighbour of both H and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81d303aa3bf35570913f5406da7b76f07b1431ca9808f68bf40d03d3f4dc3652.png] 

3) C is to the immediate right to E.

4) No other person is sitting in the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c429878fc87a5fa40b116c8c881645b5de096da22070380f744eb1adcbd7ff7a.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, total number of persons seated is nine.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
